risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company has a structured cybersecurity program led by an experienced CIO (25+ years in IT, 20+ with Taylor Morrison) and a dedicated team with specialized certifications. However, cyberattacks remain a significant evolving threat.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to multiple government regulations affecting its operations across 12 states. These regulations are constantly evolving.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: TMHC operates in a highly competitive market with constant price adjustments and financing strategies to maintain competitiveness.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: Legal provisions increased to $53.3M in 2025 vs $49.1M in 2024, indicating significant litigation exposure in homebuilding operations.

risks.title: Reputation
risks.score_rationale: As a major homebuilder, reputation is critical for consumer trust and brand strength. Quality or service incidents can significantly impact sales.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: TMHC operates primarily in the United States (12 states). Direct geopolitical exposure is limited, although supply chains may be indirectly affected.

risks.title: Technology
risks.score_rationale: Reliance on IT systems for core operations creates risks of technological failure. Investments in cybersecurity partially mitigate this risk.

ai_positioning.summary: TMHC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
